description.value:
This grip of this dagger resembles a blackened and burned piece of ashen wood. You can Interact to touch the tip of this dagger to a torch, tinder, or a flammable substance to ignite a flame.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ignition]
  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Breathe Fire]
  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Blazing Bolt]
  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fireball]

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
